defs.def: 蜘蛛在窗外结了一张完整的网。

ex.s: Every night it goes on the web, keeping parents and the world informed of the happenings at Pali.
ex.t: 它每晚都会上网，让家长和全世界了解帕利（Pali）发生的事情。

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: 数学模型还揭示，食物网可能并不稳定——顶级捕食者的微小变化会在整个生态系统中引发巨大影响。在20世纪60年代，科学家提出，食物网顶端的捕食者对其他物种种群的数量有着惊人的控制力，包括它们并未直接攻击的物种。

ex.s: （1）What have scientists discovered with the help of mathematical models of food webs？
ex.t: （1）科学家借助食物网的数学模型发现了什么？

ex.s: A．The living habits of species in food webs．
ex.t: A．食物网中物种的生活习性。

ex.s: B．The rules governing food webs of the ecosystems．
ex.t: B．支配生态系统食物网的规则。

ex.s: D．The differences between weak and strong links in food webs．
ex.t: D．食物网中弱链接与强链接的差异。

ex.s: （3）What will happen if the populations of top predators in a food web greatly decline？
ex.t: （3）如果一个食物网中顶级捕食者的数量大幅减少，会发生什么？

ex.s: D．Industrial activities help keep food webs stable．
ex.t: D．工业活动有助于保持食物网稳定。

defs.def: a complicated pattern of things that are closely connected to each other 网状物；网络；错综复杂的事物

ex.s: B Written more than two hundred years ago, these lines by Walter Scott remain one of the most well-known excerpts of Scottish poetry: Oh, what a tangled web we weave, When first we practise to deceive!
ex.t: B 写于两百多年前，沃尔特·司各特这几行诗仍是苏格兰诗歌中最著名的片段之一：哦，我们一开始欺骗，便织就一团乱麻！

ex.s: Scientists call this system the “wood wide web”.
ex.t: 科学家将这一系统称为“木维网”（wood wide web）。

ex.s: While the Internet is a worldwide network of computers linked by cables and satellites, the wood wide web is linked underground by fungi.
ex.t: 互联网是通过电缆和卫星连接的全球计算机网络，而“木维网”则是由真菌在地下连接而成的。

ex.s: Using the wood wide web, plants can share information and even food with each other.
ex.t: 借助“木维网”，植物可以相互分享信息甚至食物。

ex.s: But just like our own Internet, the wood wide web has its own version of ‘‘cybercrime”.
ex.t: 但就像我们的互联网一样，“木维网”也有它自己的“网络犯罪”版本。
